scanNote:
7-UNITNING BEShINChI BETI (52-bet).

Yuqorida chapda KO'K yorliqda oq '7' va 'Profiles'.

CHAP USTUN:
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
21) 'Who is Bill Gates? Look at the picture and describe him.'
22) a) 'Read the article and match the paragraphs to the headings, then explain the words in bold.' Sarlavhalar: Character/Likes/Plans ......, Introduction ......, Early Life ......, Later Life ......
   MAQOLA (sarg'ish fonda, yirtiq qog'oz shaklida): SURAT - ko'zoynakli, qizil-qora ko'ylakli, och rangli shimda Bill Gates stulda o'tirib kitob o'qimoqda. Katta qora harflar 'Bill Gates'. To'rt xatboshi, ko'k raqamli belgilar 1-4. Qalin so'zlar: billionaire, private school, operating program, mixed feelings, running, experiences, generous, wealth, retires.

O'NG USTUN:
   b) 'Read the article again and answer the questions.' 1 Who is Bill Gates? 2 What have he and Paul Allen done together? 3 Why has Gates been so successful? 4 What does he do in his free time? 5 What does he plan to do with all his money?
23) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and complete the table.' KO'K JADVAL: Full Name: William Henry Gates III | Born: 28 October, ........., in Seattle, USA | Early Life: • very intelligent, especially good at Maths and Science • parents sent him to Lakeside, a private school • finished school in ......... | Later Life: • went to Harvard • started Microsoft in 1975 (with Paul Allen), left Harvard • married Melinda French in ......... • wrote The Road Ahead in ......... | Character: ambitious, hardworking, generous | Likes: puzzles, golf, reading about science | Plans: to give away almost all of his wealth
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Use the information in Ex. 23 to talk about Bill Gates.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Communication: Asking For & Giving Permission'.
24) Kasseta belgisi: 'Read the two dialogues below and fill in the correct form of the verbs in bold. Listen and check your answers. Then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts below.'
   1 A: Can I GO OUT with my friends? B: ......... (you/do) YOUR HOMEWORK yet? A: Yes, I ......... (already/do) it. B: ......... (you/take) THE DOG FOR A WALK? A: Yes, I have. B: Well, you ......... (do) everything, so you can GO OUT. (tagi chizilgan iboralar)
   Qiya: go to the cinema - do the dusting - wash the car
   2 A: Is it alright if I PLAY ON MY COMPUTER? B: ......... (you/wash) THE DISHES yet? A: No, I haven't, but I'll WASH THEM later. B: Sorry - WASH THE DISHES first, and THEN you can PLAY ON YOUR COMPUTER.
   Qiya: watch TV - tidy your bedroom

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '52'.

exercises.instructionEn: Who is Bill Gates? Look at the picture and describe him.
exercises.instructionUz: Bill Gates kim? Suratga qarab uni tasvirlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
SURATDAN TASVIRLASh.

⚠ 'TO DESCRIBE':
  = tasvirlamoq.
  ⚠ 'a description' = tasvir.

⚠ Bill Gates - Microsoft asoschisi,
dunyodagi eng boy odamlardan biri.
(Kitob 1990-yillar oxirida yozilgan.)

items.answerEn: He is the founder of Microsoft and one of the richest people in the world.
items.answerUz: U Microsoft asoschisi va dunyodagi eng boy odamlardan biri.

items.en: Look at the picture and describe him.
items.answerEn: He is a middle-aged man with fair hair and glasses. He is wearing a red and black shirt and light trousers, and he is sitting on a chair reading a book.
items.answerUz: U och sochli, ko'zoynakli o'rta yoshli erkak. Qizil-qora ko'ylak va och rangli shim kiygan, stulda o'tirib kitob o'qiyapti.

exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI - to'rt xatboshi.


⚠ MAQOLADA IKKI ZAMON ARALASh:

  PRESENT PERFECT (vaqtsiz / hozirga
  bog'liq):
    'Everyone HAS HEARD of Bill Gates'
    'Microsoft HAS BECOME the
     world's largest'
    'the company HAS CONTINUED to
     grow'
    'Gates HAS always BEEN ambitious'
    'This HAS NOT LEFT him much time'
    'experiences I HAVEN'T HAD'
    'He HAS already GIVEN huge
     amounts'

  PAST SIMPLE (aniq vaqt):
    'he STARTED with a friend IN
     1975'
    'WAS the youngest billionaire AT
     THE AGE OF 31'
    'WAS BORN on 28th October, 1955'
    'WENT to Harvard' (1973)
    'MARRIED Melinda IN 1994'
    'WROTE a book IN 1995'

  ⚠ Har gapda VAQT bor-yo'qligiga
  qarang - shu zamonni belgilaydi.


⚠ 'WILLIAM HENRY GATES III':

  'III' = 'the Third' (uchinchi) -
  oilada shu ismli uchinchi odam.

points.en: [1] Everyone has heard of Bill Gates, one of the richest and most successful people in the world. Microsoft, the business he started with a friend in 1975, has become the world's largest computer software company, and Gates was the world's youngest billionaire at the age of 31.
points.uz: [1] Bill Gates haqida hamma eshitgan - u dunyodagi eng boy va eng muvaffaqiyatli odamlardan biri. U 1975 yilda do'sti bilan boshlagan Microsoft kompaniyasi dunyodagi eng katta kompyuter dasturlari kompaniyasiga aylandi va Gates 31 yoshida dunyodagi eng yosh milliarder edi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'HAS HEARD OF' - 'hear of' = ... haqida
eshitmoq.
⚠ 'the business (that) he started' - 'that'
tushirilgan.
⚠ 'at the age of 31' = 31 yoshida.

points.en: [2] His full name is William Henry Gates III, and he was born on 28th October, 1955, in Seattle, USA. At school, Bill soon showed that he was very intelligent, and especially good at Maths and Science.
points.uz: [2] Uning to'liq ismi - Uilyam Genri Geyts III, u 1955 yil 28-oktabrda AQShning Sietl shahrida tug'ilgan. Maktabda Bill tez orada juda aqlli ekanini, ayniqsa matematika va fanlarda kuchli ekanini ko'rsatdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'was born ON 28th October' - sana oldidan 'on'.
⚠ 'good AT Maths' - 'at' predlogi.
⚠ 'especially' = ayniqsa.

points.en: His parents decided to send him to Lakeside, the private school where he first began to use computers. 13-year-old Bill Gates and his schoolfriend Paul Allen were soon spending all their time writing programs and learning about computers instead of doing their schoolwork!
points.uz: Ota-onasi uni Lakeside xususiy maktabiga yuborishga qaror qildi - u yerda u birinchi marta kompyuterdan foydalana boshladi. 13 yoshli Bill Gates va maktabdosh do'sti Pol Allen tez orada butun vaqtini maktab ishlari o'rniga dastur yozish va kompyuterni o'rganishga sarflay boshladi!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a private school' = xususiy maktab.
⚠ 'instead of' + -ING.
⚠ 'were spending' - PAST CONTINUOUS.

points.en: [3] After finishing school in 1973, Bill went to Harvard, America's most famous university. The next year, he and Paul Allen wrote an operating program for the Altair, one of the world's first microcomputers.
points.uz: [3] 1973 yilda maktabni tugatgach, Bill Amerikaning eng mashhur universiteti Harvardga kirdi. Keyingi yili u va Pol Allen dunyodagi birinchi mikrokompyuterlardan biri - Altair uchun operatsion dastur yozdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'After finishING' - 'after' + -ING.
⚠ 'an operating program' = operatsion dastur.
⚠ 'wrote' - aniq vaqt ('the next year').

points.en: The two friends started Microsoft in 1975, and Gates left Harvard. Before long, Microsoft was a major business success. Since then, the company has continued to grow, producing most of the world's leading PC software.
points.uz: Ikki do'st 1975 yilda Microsoftni boshladi va Gates Harvardni tashlab ketdi. Ko'p o'tmay Microsoft katta biznes muvaffaqiyatiga aylandi. O'shandan beri kompaniya o'sishda davom etib, dunyodagi yetakchi shaxsiy kompyuter dasturlarining ko'pini ishlab chiqarmoqda.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'before long' = ko'p o'tmay.
⚠ 'SINCE THEN, the company HAS CONTINUED' -
present perfect + since.
⚠ 'leading' = yetakchi.

points.en: One reason for his success is that Gates has always been very ambitious and hardworking. This has not left him much time for a normal personal life, but in 1994 he married Melinda French, a Microsoft employee, and in 1995 he wrote a best-selling book, The Road Ahead.
points.uz: Muvaffaqiyatining bir sababi - Gates har doim juda intiluvchan va mehnatkash bo'lgan. Bu unga oddiy shaxsiy hayot uchun ko'p vaqt qoldirmadi, lekin 1994 yilda u Microsoft xodimi Melinda Frenchga uylandi va 1995 yilda 'The Road Ahead' nomli eng ko'p sotilgan kitobni yozdi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'HAS always BEEN' - 'always' o'rtada.
⚠ 'to marry sb' - PREDLOGSIZ ('married WITH'
XATO).
⚠ 'best-selling' = eng ko'p sotiladigan.

points.en: [4] Bill has mixed feelings about spending so much time running Microsoft. "There are a lot of experiences I haven't had, but I do like my job," he says. When he does find time to relax, he likes puzzles, golf and reading about science.
points.uz: [4] Bill Microsoftni boshqarishga shuncha vaqt sarflash haqida aralash his-tuyg'ularga ega. "Men boshdan kechirmagan ko'p tajribalar bor, lekin ishimni haqiqatan yaxshi ko'raman", - deydi u. Dam olishga vaqt topganda u boshqotirmalar, golf va fan haqida o'qishni yoqtiradi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'mixed feelings' = aralash his-tuyg'ular.
⚠ 'to run a company' = kompaniyani boshqarmoq.
⚠ 'I DO like' - 'do' urg'u uchun: haqiqatan.
⚠ 'experiences (that) I haven't had'.

points.en: For such a rich person, his life is simple, and he spends little on himself and his family. When it comes to helping others, though, Gates is very generous. He has already given huge amounts of money to charity, and says that he plans to give away almost all of his wealth when he retires.
points.uz: Bunday boy odam uchun uning hayoti oddiy va u o'ziga va oilasiga kam sarflaydi. Lekin boshqalarga yordam berishga kelganda Gates juda saxiy. U allaqachon xayriyaga katta miqdorda pul bergan va nafaqaga chiqqanida deyarli butun boyligini berib yuborishni rejalashtirayotganini aytadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'when it comes to' = ... ga kelganda.
⚠ 'generous' = saxiy.
⚠ 'charity' = xayriya.
⚠ 'to give away' = berib yubormoq (tekin).
⚠ 'when he RETIRES' - vaqt ergash gapida
present simple.

exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va xatboshilarni sarlavhalarga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RT SARLAVHA - TO'RT XATBOShI.

  1 → INTRODUCTION (kim, nima uchun
      mashhur)
  2 → EARLY LIFE (tug'ilgan, maktab)
  3 → LATER LIFE (Harvard, Microsoft,
      nikoh, kitob)

      rejalar)


⚠ PROFIL TUZILIShI:

  Odam haqida maqola (profile)

  bolalik → keyingi hayot → xarakter.
  ⚠ 54-betdagi yozish topshirig'ida
  shu reja kerak bo'ladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL - JAVOBLAR MATNDA.

⚠ 2-SAVOL: 'What HAVE he and Paul

⚠ 3-SAVOL: 'Why HAS Gates BEEN so

items.answerEn: He is one of the richest and most successful people in the world, and the founder of Microsoft.
items.answerUz: U dunyodagi eng boy va muvaffaqiyatli odamlardan biri, Microsoft asoschisi.

items.en: 2 What have he and Paul Allen done together?
items.uz: 2 U va Pol Allen birga nima qilishgan?
items.answerEn: They wrote an operating program for the Altair and started Microsoft together in 1975.
items.answerUz: Ular Altair uchun operatsion dastur yozishdi va 1975 yilda birga Microsoftni boshlashdi.

items.en: 3 Why has Gates been so successful?
items.answerEn: Because he has always been very ambitious and hardworking.
items.answerUz: Chunki u har doim juda intiluvchan va mehnatkash bo'lgan.

items.en: 4 What does he do in his free time?
items.answerEn: He likes puzzles, golf and reading about science.
items.answerUz: U boshqotirmalar, golf va fan haqida o'qishni yoqtiradi.

items.en: 5 What does he plan to do with all his money?
items.uz: 5 U butun pulini nima qilishni rejalashtiryapti?
items.answerEn: He plans to give away almost all of his wealth to charity when he retires.
items.answerUz: U nafaqaga chiqqanida deyarli butun boyligini xayriyaga berib yuborishni rejalashtiryapti.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information in Ex. 23 to talk about Bill Gates.
exercises.instructionUz: 23-mashqdagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Bill Gates haqida gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JADVALDAN GAPIRISh.

⚠ Jadvaldagi QISQA qaydlarni TO'LIQ
gaplarga aylantiring:
  'went to Harvard' → 'He went to
  Harvard.'

⚠ Zamonlar:
  Bolalik/keyingi hayot → PAST SIMPLE
  Xarakter/yoqtirgan → PRESENT SIMPLE
  Rejalar → 'plans to' / 'is going to'

U 1994 yilda Melinda Frenchga uylandi va 1995 yilda 'The Road Ahead' kitobini yozdi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the two dialogues below and fill in the correct form of the verbs in bold. Listen and check your answers.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ikki dialogni o'qing va qalin fe'llarning to'g'ri shaklini qo'ying. Tinglab javoblaringizni tekshiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RUXSAT SO'RASh - PRESENT PERFECT
BILAN.


TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

  1 A: Can I go out with my friends?
    B: HAVE YOU DONE your homework
       yet?
    A: Yes, I'VE ALREADY DONE it.
    B: HAVE YOU TAKEN the dog for a
       walk?
    A: Yes, I have.
    B: Well, you'VE DONE everything,
       so you can go out.

  2 A: Is it alright if I play on my
       computer?
    B: HAVE YOU WASHED the dishes yet?
    A: No, I haven't, but I'll wash
       them later.
    B: Sorry - wash the dishes first,
       and then you can play on your
       computer.


⚠ RUXSAT SO'RASh:

  Can I ...?
  Is it alright if I ...?
  ⚠ 'Could I ...?' / 'May I ...?' -
  muloyimroq.


⚠ RUXSAT BERISh:

  'You can go out.'
  'Yes, you can.'


⚠ RAD ETISh:

  'Sorry - wash the dishes first.'


⚠ NEGA PRESENT PERFECT?

  'Have you done ... YET?' - ish
  tugaganmi, natijasi hozir muhim.
  ⚠ 'yet' savolda, oxirida.
  ⚠ 'already' javobda, o'rtada.


⚠ 'ALRIGHT':

  = 'all right' (so'zlashuv imlosi).
  ⚠ 'Is it alright if ...?' = ...
  bo'ladimi?


⚠ 'TO TAKE THE DOG FOR A WALK':

  = itni sayr qildirmoq.

exercises.instructionUz: So'ng juftlikda quyidagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'RSATMALAR:

  1-dialog uchun: go to the cinema -
     do the dusting - wash the car
  2-dialog uchun: watch TV - tidy
     your bedroom


⚠ 'TO DO THE DUSTING':

  = chang artmoq.
  ⚠ 'dust' = chang.
  ⚠ Uy yumushi → 'DO'.
